review.ratingHint: Known / Unknown decides when this word comes back

review.showAnswer: Click the card or press Space to reveal

sets.title: Word sets
sets.name: Name
sets.batchBody: This affects {{count}} word sets. Delete is soft and does not affect sent assignments.
sets.saveFirst: Save the word set before adding words.
sets.pastePlaceholder: Paste or type words (one per line, comma or space separated)
sets.removeHint: "Remove" only takes the word out of this set: the word and students' progress are untouched.
sets.copyHint: Students open this link to preview this assignment. Only recipients in the class can open it; teachers see a notice instead.
sets.copyDone: Copied. Send it to the class; only recipient students can open it.

sets.bulkPlaceholder: Paste or type words (one per line or comma/space separated; parsed and added when you press Save)
sets.noWordsParsed: No words parsed; check the content

lists.title: My word lists
lists.sub: Collect the words you want to learn into lists and start reviewing from any list. A word can belong to several lists; you still have only one progress record.
lists.nameLabel: Name (1–80 characters, unique among your lists)
lists.descPlaceholder: Why you are collecting these words
lists.emptyBody: Collect the words you want to learn into a list: when you look up a word, press the add-to-list icon, then review from that list whenever you like.
lists.limitNote: {{count}} lists · limit {{max}} (the New list button is disabled at the limit)
lists.limitReached: You already have the maximum of {{max}} lists. Delete one before creating another.
lists.deleteBody: Deleting the list does not delete the words or your learning progress; the {{count}} words stay in your library and still appear in other lists and in today's review.
lists.deletedToast: Deleted the list "{{name}}"; words and progress are unchanged
lists.nameTooLong: The name can be at most 80 characters
lists.duplicateName: You already have a list named "{{name}}". Choose another name (names are case-insensitive).
lists.nameHint: A new list is empty: 0 words. Add words later from the word page or from this list.
lists.editHint: Renaming changes only this list; words and learning progress are untouched.
lists.notFound: This list does not exist; it may have been deleted.
lists.pausedChip: {{count}} paused, not in the review scope
lists.addWordsHint: One word form per line, or paste a space/comma separated run. Words already in this list are not counted twice.
lists.addWordsEmpty: Paste at least one word form first
lists.addWordsDone: Added {{added}} words; {{duplicated}} were already in the list
lists.emptyDetailBody: Use "Add words" above to pick from your library, or look up a word and press the add-to-list icon in the card header.
lists.removedToast: Removed from the list; the word stays in your library
lists.removeHint: Removing deletes only the reference: the word and your progress stay, and the word remains in your library. Deleting the whole list works the same way.
lists.pausedNote: Paused words stay in the list; they are just not part of the review scope
lists.reviewNone: This list has no words to review
lists.reviewNoneHint: Every word in this list is paused. Resume them to start a review.
lists.reviewCapped: This round reviews the first {{limit}} words ({{count}} reviewable in this list)
lists.formsTooLong: {{count}} word forms are longer than 64 characters and were ignored
lists.addToListsHint: You can select several lists. A word can belong to many lists; you still have only one progress record.
lists.addToListsNotInLibrary: This word is not in your library yet; adding it to a list also adds it to your library first.
lists.alreadyToast: Already in the list "{{name}}"; not counted twice
lists.noListsHint: No lists yet. Type a name below and it will be created and used at once.
lists.pickOrCreate: Select a list first, or type the name of a new list

assign.empty: No word sets available to send yet.
assign.infoStudents: Students see a to-preview banner on the library page and add the words to their own library.
assign.infoSnapshot: Sending snapshots the word set; later edits do not affect sent assignments.
assign.infoRepeat: Sending the same set again does not duplicate words; claimed words only gain a source.

detail.familyMissing: Word family pending (not in local list)
detail.notInLibraryHint: This word is not in your library yet. Add it and it is due today.
detail.alreadyToast: Already in your library; nothing duplicated
detail.resumeBody: {{word}} goes back to new and is due today. Review logs are kept.
detail.feedbackPlaceholder: What is wrong? For example the meaning, an example or the phonetic.

freeReview.skipToast: Skipped this card (no log, no schedule change)

add.spellingOff: Word list not loaded; spelling was not checked

assignment.teacherLinkBody: Teacher accounts cannot open the student preview page. Send the link to students in the class; they can open it and add the words to their library.
